method: EXIF orientation; global white balance and exposure from the 95th-percentile RGB of one blank paper patch; crop retaining plotter and hanging sheet; original perspective and illumination variation retained; Lanczos display resize; JPEG 94, 4:4:4.
limits: Display correction, not a calibrated measurement of ink color. No stroke replacement, inpainting, sharpening or generated artwork. A homography does not flatten paper curl.
